name: Smart Lighting
source: Smart Lighting Panel V1.0.3 exact + Suite layout runtime V1.2.0 + responsive runtime V1.1.0
frontend_source: Smart Lighting Panel V1.0.3 + smart-lighting-layout.js + smart-lighting-responsive.js
layout_runtime_source: Preserves device ordering, lets Global Actions participate in area ordering, reorders global buttons, and adds active/inactive colors without modifying the validated base frontend
responsive_runtime_source: Keeps mobile Global Actions unchanged and aligns their buttons to the same configurable tablet/desktop grid used by device cards; adaptive 520/760 layout remains unchanged
global_actions_responsive: mobile keeps the original two-column full-width layout; tablet/desktop inherit columns_tablet/columns_desktop and occupy the leftmost grid slots
migration: none; existing .storage configuration remains valid and is never rewritten by the responsive runtime
global_actions_storage: optional global_actions position, button_order and active/inactive color fields inside existing smart_lighting_panel.config; no storage migration
